description: Ministry of Health - Food Act, No 26 of 1980, Amended the Food (Colour Coding for Sugar Levels-Liquid) Regulation 2022
reasoning: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Health under the Food Act, No. 26 of 1980. It specifically amends the Food (Colour Coding for sugar levels-liquid) Regulations 2022, which constitutes regulatory framework and compliance requirements for food labeling. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation rather than government personnel changes or structural modifications.
